exposure: Male factor infertility conceived by ART
outcome: Histopathologic alterations of term placentas (anatomic, inflammatory, villous maturation, vascular malperfusion disorders)
Perinatal complications (early pregnancy bleeding, imminent preterm labor, preeclampsia, preterm birth)
Vascular malperfusion disorders (subchorionic and perivillous fibrin, intervillous thrombosis, high grade fetal vascular malperfusion)
cohort: The study included term placentas from 107 women with singleton pregnancies, divided into three groups: women with endometriosis-related infertility conceived by ART, healthy women with male factor infertility conceived by ART, and healthy women with spontaneous pregnancies.
finding: The study found that women with endometriosis-related infertility conceived by ART had higher occurrences of increased syncytial knotting and vascular malperfusion placental disorders, shorter placental cords, and an association with placental cord hypercoiling compared to control groups.
mod_finding: Endometriosis and male factor groups had a higher occurrence of Cesarean delivery.
cross-section timing: Analysis of term placentas collected within the Department of Obstetrics and Gynecology, after birth.
birth_weight: Newborns in the endometriosis group had the lowest birthweight.
